profiles.finding: Handy August29–30,1864, printed pp529–531: Noel among political prisoners removed on August29; next day author reports unconditional release. No initial arrest/admission. Earlier May entry for Capt F.S.Noel, staff of General Bowen, does not establish identity with civilian Noel; do not merge the custody records. Existing release not changed because precise physical release timing remains ambiguous.

profiles.result: Personal custody episode not established in reviewed source passages
profiles.finding: Downloaded and searched Pillsbury Acts of the Anti-Slavery Apostles OCR. Prison narratives include first-person quotations by Foster, Harriman and Beach, not automatically Pillsbury. Printed p316 specifically says threatened prosecutions did not occur and Rogers and author returned to New Hampshire Tuesday. No arrest or custody dates assigned to Pillsbury from companions imprisonments. Existing profile preserved, no conclusion that he was never jailed.
